consequence.statement: New OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics support is added; the evidence states no operational consequence for existing setups.

original.statement: OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics support was added in Traefik 3.0.0.

decision.reason: The changelog lists this under "Enhancements" and says only that OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics support was added [ev-5ce528be35f7]. Nothing in the evidence says that existing configuration fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. For an environment that does nothing, "none" (informational) is therefore the supported reading. Confidence is low because the excerpt does not say outright that there is no effect on existing setups.
